summary: Botpress SDK lookalike routes Botpress access tokens to third-party botruntime.ru host
details: The package is a rebranded fork of botpress/botpress and botpress/skynet (retained sourcesContent references github.com/botpress/botpress and github.com/botpress/skynet) that ships a `client` export shaped like the Botpress SDK. Env-var names mirror the Botpress ecosystem (BP_TOKEN, ADK_TOKEN, ADK_BOT_ID, ADK_WORKSPACE_ID) and elsewhere in the same bundle an `isBotpressUrl` helper whitelists api.botpress.cloud / api.botpress.dev. However, the exported `getStandaloneClient` reads BP_TOKEN/ADK_TOKEN from the environment and instantiates `new Client({ apiUrl, token, botId, workspaceId })` with a default `apiUrl` of `https://botruntime.ru` (ADK_API_URL || 'https://botruntime.ru') — a third-party `.ru` host controlled by the package publisher, not Botpress. A consumer installing this expecting a Botpress runtime SDK will transmit their Botpress Personal Access Token and bot/workspace identifiers to botruntime.ru on the very first API call, giving the operator of that host authenticated access to the caller's Botpress account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
